seoDescription: Learn about Naya Aasha's story, mission, vision, values, and community-centered approach.
title: A new hope, built together.
intro: Naya Aasha is a nonprofit initiative committed to supporting children, people living with HIV, low-income families, and underserved communities in Nepal.
story: Naya Aasha was created from a simple belief: difficult circumstances should never decide the limits of a person’s future. We bring people, skills, and resources together to help communities address urgent needs while building pathways toward long-term independence.
mission: To empower children, people living with HIV, and underserved communities by improving access to education, health support, essential resources, and sustainable opportunities.
vision: A compassionate and inclusive society where every person can live with dignity, hope, and equal opportunity, regardless of economic condition, health status, identity, or background.

values.title: Dignity
values.text: We respect every person’s worth, privacy, rights, and choices.

values.title: Compassion
values.text: We listen with empathy and respond with practical care.

values.title: Inclusion
values.text: We serve without discrimination and work to remove barriers.

values.title: Empowerment
values.text: We support people to build skills, confidence, and independence.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: We communicate openly about our decisions, resources, and results.

values.title: Collaboration
values.text: We create lasting change by working with communities and partners.
